native_fixture.mode: Operator-driven mouse/keyboard and WM_DELETE_WINDOW with observed screenshots and X11 window inventory; actual GTK/WebKit utility windows, not browser popups.

setup_and_limits: The first native harness attempt used an incorrect SI configuration command and stopped before launching a GUI; corrected only the ignored harness, not product code.

An initial software-configured native session emitted failed AMD initialization probes. It was stopped without running window checks. The completed session ran with a private /dev containing no GPU devices; no Radeon reset/rebind or hardware performance test was performed.

The private SI chat-state command is intentionally unavailable through attached MCP. Native draft continuity was verified in the actual UI, not by bypassing that boundary. Native SI remained disconnected; no active request was exercised natively. The independent browser suite verified running requests, cancellation, reload/close/reopen and no duplicate sends, using exactly six local mock calls.

Native correctness applies to Xvfb/X11 GTK/WebKit with software rendering. This is not GNOME/Wayland desktop acceptance, a GPU performance result, or Mac/Windows validation. Headless portal/PipeWire warnings and 34 existing vendored GLib dependency warnings were retained; product strict Clippy passed.
This is selected detachable-panel verification plus the complete core Rust matrix, not all 52 browser suites, all native platforms, downloadable-package acceptance, or an FPS benchmark.

The upcoming continuous-column/per-table-search UX is not covered by these frozen results. The new field-paging assertion intentionally targets the current old UI and must be adapted by the coordinating branch.
